summary: 37 units reviewed. Most renderings are faithful and cautious. Errors: u41 English supplies a noun ('what has arisen'); u52 spurious text_flag (मध्यमपि is regular madhyam+api); u55 'probable' khalita unhedged in translations; u61 silent emendation anādhika>anadhika unflagged. Minor: Hindi missing the sattva=mind, agni=digestive fire, bīja/kṣetra glosses the English carries; a few notes/format items. No wrong plant/drug identifications (none present). Human decisions: u43 bhedāgram, u45 anūka/syntax, u51 sneha, u53 paripāka scope, u56 udīraṇa compound and ślatha split, u58-59 bālyam, u64 apuṇya, u69 ūrjaskara-yoga, u72 guṇa scope, copula policy for list units (50, 53, 56, 58, 72). No regrouping beyond the draft's own 58-59 and 63-64 notes.
